steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Introduction: name the production, company, venue, date and the production's overall intention. | Key Fact: SEE framework: State the technique, Evidence from the production, Effect on the audience — use for every analytical point. | Key Fact: Analysis paragraphs: focus on one aspect per paragraph (e.g. performance, then design, then direction). | Key Fact: Conclusion: evaluate the overall effectiveness — did the production achieve its intention? Sum up your judgement.

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: Describe the structure of a theatre review for the GCSE written exam. | What is the SEE framework and how does it improve your written analysis? | How can you ensure your theatre review is analytical rather than just descriptive?
